title: Food Chains and Life Cycles
seo_title: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology: Food Chains and Life Cycles Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology: Food chains; life cycles
standard_text: Food chains show how energy passes from the Sun to producers (plants) and then to consumers (herbivores, carnivores and omnivores). All plants and animals have life cycles: they are born or germinate, grow, reproduce and die. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 5, Life and Living: Food chains; life cycles)
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): producers and consumers, herbivores, carnivores and omnivores, food chains, and life cycles of plants and animals. 100 questions with answers.

key_sub: Arrows point to the animal that eats.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants are producers: they make their own food using sunlight. Animals are consumers. Herbivores eat plants (an impala), carnivores eat animals (a lion), and omnivores eat both (a baboon). A food chain: grass → impala → lion.

A life cycle is the stages a living thing goes through. A frog: egg → tadpole → froglet → frog. A butterfly: egg → caterpillar → pupa → butterfly. A plant: seed → seedling → adult plant → flower → seed.

Example

In grass → impala → lion, which is the carnivore?

It eats meat.

Answer: the lion

Example

What comes after the pupa in a butterfly's life cycle?

It comes out of the pupa.

Answer: the adult butterfly

Common mistakes

  • Drawing the arrow from the eater to the food.
  • Thinking a tadpole is a different animal from a frog.
  • Starting a food chain with an animal.

faq.q: What would happen to lions if all the impala died?
faq.a: The lions would have less food and their numbers would drop.
Seeds grow into new plants, so the plant's life cycle continues.

items.q: What does the young shoot of a seed do?

items.q: Does a seed need fertiliser to germinate?
c: Yes, but only in the day.
No. A seed can germinate without it.
Yes. A seed cannot germinate without it.
items.e: Seeds can germinate on wet cotton wool in the dark. They need minerals from the soil later, when the young plant grows.
